{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.10

|arg= global

|eff= local

|gr1= Briefing

|descr= Returns array with all [[Diary]] Records for the given subject available to the given person. See [[Diary]] for the explanation on the available subjects and their structure.

|s1= person [[allDiaryRecords]] subject

|p1= person: [[Object]] - unit
|p2= subject: [[String]] - subject

|r1= [[Array]] with [id, title, text, icon, task, taskState, showTitle, date, record]
* id: [[Number]] - record id
* title: [[String]] - record title
* text: [[String]] - record text
* icon: [[String]] - record icon
* task: [[Task]] - record task
* taskState: [[String]] - record task state
* showTitle: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] if tile is shown
* date: [[Date]]
* record: [[Diary Record]] - record reference

|x1= <sqf>player allDiaryRecords "Diary";</sqf>

|seealso= [[allDiarySubjects]] [[createDiaryRecord]] [[setDiaryRecordText]] [[Diary]]
}}
